info.title: Enterprise Vision MLOps Control Panel API
info.description: Multi-cycle metadata and guarded mutation contract for the enterprise MLOps Control Panel, including versioned human-authored pipeline profiles, persistent dependency-aware lifecycle runs, runtime task dispatch, CI evidence, deployment intent state transitions, organizational service scope, drift review, CD/CT gates, and real-test Torch EfficientNet model matrices.

get.summary: Search and list live and historical lifecycle cycles.
Return one lifecycle cycle with lineage, stages, artifacts, serving state, and resource refs.
Return the latest known cycle for dashboard landing state.
Return normalized Kubernetes and external worker resource state.
Return orchestrator connection contracts for Airflow, MLflow, and Kubernetes control targets.
Return the local task assignment ledger.

post.summary: Draft or queue an Airflow/MLflow-aware task assignment.

get.summary: Return a CycleRun-derived default task assignment draft.

post.summary: Dispatch a queued task through its registered runtime adapter.

409.description: task cannot be dispatched by the selected runtime adapter

post.summary: Confirm a manual task assignment before runtime dispatch.

409.description: task state or external approval policy rejected confirmation

get.summary: Return the local command intent audit ledger.

post.summary: Create an auditable command intent for Kubernetes, Airflow, or MLflow actions.
Confirm a dry-run command intent for application.
Cancel a pending command intent.
Evaluate target environment promotion policy from current server evidence.

get.summary: Return the auditable deployment intent ledger.

post.summary: Admit a dry-run deployment intent after CI, readiness, and environment policy validation.

409.description: CI, readiness, policy, or ledger admission blocked

post.summary: Move a dry-run deployment intent to pending approval.
Record a separate authorized approver without applying the deployment.
Revalidate all gates and queue an approved intent for the isolated executor.

409.description: current CI, readiness, policy, or version check rejected

get.summary: Return structured blocked and warning causes with source freshness and evidence links.
Return the latest measured drift review workflow without triggering retraining or deployment.

post.summary: Preview or apply an audited drift review state transition.
Create a draft lifecycle decision record.
Apply an optimistic and separation-of-duties protected decision transition.

get.summary: Return the schema-valid default human-authored pipeline profile.

post.summary: Validate and save an immutable pipeline profile version.
Validate a profile and render execution capability without runtime mutation.
Preview or queue an executable immutable profile version.

202.description: profile launch preview or queued task

409.description: profile is blocked, invalid, or not executable

post.summary: Create a dry-run preview or queue an immutable full lifecycle run.

get.summary: Return host lifecycle worker heartbeat and current claim.
Read one persistent lifecycle run and its stage evidence.

post.summary: Queue a validated dry-run snapshot using optimistic locking.
Cancel non-terminal lifecycle work using optimistic locking.
Retry the current failed or blocked stage within its attempt policy.
Record independent approval and release the deployment dependency.

409.description: requester and approver conflict or transition rejected
